summary: Interpreted the default-configuration reproduction and closed the constructor question's reachability limit. Receipt e0d98aadc54b461792883fc8a2a82676 ran the live scenario with MaxAppendEntries left at the default 64 and a gap of about 8300 committed entries above the follower's snapshot: the feature-on restart never returned within the window (violated, witness index 1), while the same stores restarted without the feature returned (holds, index 3), stayed at the snapshot index (applied_at_snapshot holds, index 3), faced 130 expected batches against the capacity of 128 observed on that very node (replay_exceeds_channel holds, index 3), and left the other two voters holding a quorum (holds, index 2). So the stall no longer rests on a non-default batch size; the experiment-level interpretation is violated/asserted with those indices, the question-level account is explained/asserted with a joint history across its four receipts, and the stall fact gained this receipt plus an updated conditions clause. The remaining limits are stated plainly: the gap is produced by delayed snapshotting arranged by the harness (ten-minute SnapshotInterval, no further snapshot on that node) rather than an observed production cadence or injected snapshot failure, and at default settings the requirement of 8193 entries sits just above the default SnapshotThreshold, so crossing it needs delay or failure; non-return is observed over a bounded window with permanence argued from source; in-memory stores, graceful shutdown and an abandoned stalled constructor without supervision. Incomplete: the repair question's unexercised user Restore and term-changing truncation paths.
